name: move_swim_bank_boost
about: Swimming into a pool's bank holding jump, with water on the floor two blocks beyond the bank, at negative and at positive x, then a lava pool: a control for 1.7.10's World.isAnyLiquid, whose scan reaches one more block on the negative side, here only the bank's own column, so both versions give the +0.3 climb boost (focus_neg_pool_climb puts the water inside that column).

frames.note: west into the pool at negative x
swim into the west bank (water beyond it)
